name: status
description: Tells people and machines whether something is happening: idle, working, done, or error. A live region, so screen readers announce changes; data-state so agents can read them.

message.description: What is happening, in plain words: 'Assistant is working'.

live.title: Announce urgently
live.description: assertive interrupts; use it only for errors.

id.description: Required when a form's enhance script should update this status while a request is in flight.

wcag.notes: Status messages are announced without moving focus (4.1.3). The working indicator pulses only when motion is allowed; the text alone carries the state. Nothing here times out or auto-dismisses.

machine.identify: Read data-state (idle, working, done, error) and the text content.
machine.operate: Not interactive. Poll data-state to know when a request has finished; a form with data-busy-target names the status it updates.

props.message: Added a table to the canvas.
